description: Decides a loan application from the applicant's credit score: declines poor scores, sends middling ones to a person, and approves good ones.

creditScore.description: The applicant's credit score, from 300 to 850

loanType.description: The kind of rate the applicant wants

firstTimeBuyer.description: Whether this is the applicant's first home

rules.name: highRiskDecline
rules.description: Declines a score under 580 and stops the chain

rules.name: requiresManualReview
rules.description: Sends a score from 580 to 679 to a loan officer

rules.name: autoApprove
rules.description: Approves a score of 680 or more
